text:
Type: stepped pine storage frame
Use: holding toy bins and storage boxes on its shelves; children's room, playroom
Style: Scandinavian, rustic, minimalist
Materials: solid pine with a clear natural finish, routed rails for sliding bins
Colors: light natural pine, pale knotty wood
Shape: open stepped shelf unit rising in three heights like a staircase, grooved side rails to slide boxes in, flat tops for display, low and sturdy, medium visual weight
Feel: warm, practical, natural, friendly
Goes with: colorful plastic bins, white walls, light wood floors, children's furniture; Scandinavian kids' rooms and playrooms

product.name: TROFAST
product.description: A playful and sturdy storage series for storing and organising toys, sitting, playing and relaxing.
